div.div: The visibility is overwritten in every case by intention. If there are external dependencies, these should be reflected in the visibility condition or an extension referencing an accompanying model instead of directly writing to the unstable field "IsVisible".

switch.text: The visibility is overwritten in ev...

div.div: The validation state is fully reset on each evaluation by intention. Like with the visibility, by design the form state should always be deterministic based on the current form values and the values in accompanying models. So if persistent errors are needed, these should be reflected in an accompanying model referenced by the validators.

div.div:
Note, that Extensions and Validators should NOT hold state on their own. They need to be stateless, because with template instantiation they might be executed on multiple different nodes and are not cloned themselves.
Instead, they may reference bound values or objects of the current node, its parents or descendants or they might reference an external model.
